card.name: Section cross-references in warnings summaries
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis or the space just before a section number in the cross-references that end bullets in a highlights summary, such as (5.11) or (2.3, 5.1).

modes.label: Opening parenthesis
modes.description: The "(" that starts a section reference after a warning sentence.

modes.label: Space before number
modes.description: The space just after "(" or a comma, right before the section number.
